title: Hybrid Search with Reciprocal Rank Fusion
signature: def hybrid_search(query, bm25, vector, top_n, candidates=50, k=60, weights=None)
hints: BM25 scores and cosine similarities live on different scales. RRF ignores the raw scores and uses only each hit's rank.
Ranks are 1-based, and a chunk that a retriever returns twice keeps only its first (best) rank.
Sort with one key: (-score, best rank, chunk_id). Fetch `candidates` hits from each retriever, not `top_n`.
